method: A raster of Fig. 3 was loaded into WebPlotDigitizer. The axes were calibrated on two ticks each, and the centre of every filled circle and the four ends of its error bars were clicked by hand.
tool: WebPlotDigitizer (saved project format 4.2; the application version is not stored in the project file)
